Services

Welcome to Laplante Cabinetry

Discover the Perfect Design for Your Kitchen and Custom Cabinetry Needs

At Laplante Cabinetry, we are dedicated to providing you with the highest quality custom cabinetry and kitchen designs. Our team of experts is committed to creating the perfect solution for your home, tailored to fit your style and needs. Let us bring your dream kitchen to life.

Custom Kitchen Design

Our custom kitchen designs are tailored to your specific needs and style, ensuring a beautiful and functional space for you and your family to enjoy. Whether you prefer a modern, traditional, or contemporary design, we have the expertise to bring your vision to reality.

Bespoke Cabinetry

Experience the luxury of bespoke cabinetry that is crafted with precision and attention to detail. Our team takes pride in delivering exquisite cabinetry solutions that enhance the aesthetics and functionality of your kitchen, providing you with a unique and timeless appeal.

Kitchen Remodeling

Transform your kitchen into a stunning and efficient space with our comprehensive kitchen remodeling services. From concept to completion, we work closely with you to ensure that every aspect of your kitchen renovation reflects your style and fulfills your practical requirements. From refinishing, new doors and hardware, cabinet modifications to complete custom kitchens. 

Custom Built-in

Elevate your home with custom furniture pieces designed to complement your kitchen and living spaces. Our artisanal approach to crafting custom furniture ensures that each piece is a harmonious blend of functionality and beauty, adding a touch of elegance to your home.

Project Management

Let us take the stress out of your kitchen design and cabinetry project with our professional project management services. From initial planning to final installation, we oversee every detail to ensure a seamless and successful execution, allowing you to enjoy the process without worries.

Space Optimization

Maximize the potential of your kitchen space with our innovative space optimization solutions. Whether you have a compact kitchen or a spacious layout, our expertise in space planning and utilization will help you achieve a harmonious balance of aesthetics and functionality.

Quality Craftsmanship

Experience the difference that quality craftsmanship makes in every aspect of your kitchen and cabinetry project. Our dedication to precision and excellence ensures that every detail is meticulously crafted to deliver exceptional results that surpass your expectations.

"Dear Ryan, 

​We appreciate your craftmanship and attention to detail.  The kitchen looks great, functions great, and exceeds our expectations in every way. Thank you."

Previous Client

Customer Satisfaction

At Laplante Cabinetry, your satisfaction is our priority. We are committed to providing unparalleled customer service and exceeding your expectations at every stage of your project. Your delight in the final outcome is our ultimate measure of success.

About Us

Crafting Excellence

Laplante Cabinetry

Laplante Cabinetry is a kitchen design and custom cabinetry company that is family owned and operated. We are passionate about creating beautiful and functional spaces for our clients. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional craftsmanship and personalized service to bring your vision to life. With a focus on quality and attention to detail, we take pride in every project we undertake.

Craftsmanship

Our dedication to craftsmanship sets us apart. We believe in the value of traditional skills combined with innovative techniques to deliver outstanding results. Each piece we create is a testament to our commitment to excellence.

Expertise

With years of experience in the industry, we have honed our expertise in creating custom designs and solutions. From concept to completion, we bring knowledge and creativity to every project, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience for our clients.

Client Focus

At Laplante and Sons, our clients are at the heart of everything we do. Building strong relationships and understanding your unique needs allows us to tailor our services to exceed your expectations, creating spaces that reflect your style and personality.

Our Vision

Transforming Spaces, Enriching Lives

Our mission is to transform spaces and enrich lives through our commitment to exceptional design, quality craftsmanship, and personalized service. We strive to create enduring value for our clients by delivering innovative solutions and timeless elegance in every project we undertake. Let us bring your vision to life and create a space that inspires and delights.
